AUTHOR: Prior, JH; Campbell, MD; Dawkins, M; Mickle, PF; Moorhead, RJ; Alaba, SY; Shah, CRJB; Salisbury, JR; Rademacher, KR; Felts, AP; Wallace, F
TITLE: Estimating precision and accuracy of automated video post-processing: A step towards implementation of AI/ML for optics-based fish sampling
REGION: Northern Gulf of Mexico shelf, west of Mississippi River Delta (GFISHER/SEAMAP-RFV)
SPECIES: Gulf of Mexico reef fishes (146 classes; 23 evaluated e.g. Red Snapper, Vermilion Snapper, Scamp)
DATA: GFISHER combined reef fish video survey: training library from 2018-2019 (and later) surveys, 603,533 annotations; evaluation on 315 25-min videos from 2021 (280 validation stations)
V_EV: Discussion: 'These false-positives were common in model 2.3 and were often associated with clouds of turbidity (Figure 9), debris, parts of the camera array'
D2: training library frames from 2018-2019 surveys; evaluation on 315 naive full-length 2021 videos
D_EV: Sec 2.3: 'Automated counts from 315, 25-minute, videos from the 2021 GFISHER combined survey were generated'; Discussion: 'models run on naive videos as opposed to evaluation of a subset of training data'
R_EV: Sec 2.1: library 'with 61.5k frame extractions from 2018 and 2019 surveys'; tested on 2021 videos; Discussion: held-out 'mAP50 of 79% for 2.4s' vs count agreement in Table 1
C_EV: Sec 2.3: 'Automated counts at the model confidence thresholds (CTs) of 0.1, 0.2, ... 0.95 were used to filter VIAME output'; Table 1 reports 'False-Positive Ratio' and best CT per species
E_EV: Fig 6: 'Linear regression is VIAME MaxN = Validation Set MaxN *(0.7) + 1 with r2 of 0.9439' (manual MaxN of same videos)
ARCH: VIAME Cascade Faster R-CNN (motion and single-frame) + ResNet50/ResNeXt101 classifiers + tracker
METR: % exact agreement, % within 1-2 counts, false-positive/negative ratios, CV, r2/slope vs manual MaxN; mAP50 (supplementary)
NOTE: External: training library built from 2018-2019 surveys and test on 2021 survey videos (same programme/region, different year -> 계절/시기 per final rule). However, model 2.4 library expanded via six months of corrections after May 2021 and the years of those additions are not stated; possible overlap with 2021 survey not excluded - verify R1/D1. R3=Y because held-out mAP50 (79%, supplementary) and 2021 count metrics are both numeric, though metrics differ. FP ratio computed per station against manual validation set -> C5. ENV coded 산호초 for GoM shelf reef structures (hard-bottom reefs; could be NR).
